input: Fix the broken fence panel in the backyard

gold.taskTitle: Fix the broken backyard fence panel
gold.taskDescription: Repair or replace a broken fence panel located in the backyard.

questions.title: What material is the fence made of?
questions.description: Identify whether the fence is wood, vinyl, metal, chain-link, or another material, as this affects tools and repair method.

questions.title: How exactly is the panel broken or damaged?
questions.description: Determine the nature of the damage, such as cracked boards, a broken post, rot, or the panel being completely detached.

questions.title: Do you already have replacement materials or tools?
questions.description: Find out whether the user needs to purchase supplies before starting the repair.

questions.title: What is your target completion date for this repair?
questions.description: Establish a deadline or urgency level to help prioritize and schedule the task.

questions.title: Will you do this yourself or hire someone?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a DIY repair or whether finding and booking a contractor is part of the task.

questions.title: Is the fence on a property boundary shared with a neighbor?
questions.description: Determine if a neighbor needs to be consulted, or if costs and permissions need to be shared.

questions.title: Are there specific fence height or style rules in your area?
questions.description: Check whether local HOA rules, permits, or municipal codes could affect how the repair is done.
